data.long_meaning: The one who opens, the victor, the one who succeeds. The name Fath carries the meaning “Opening, victory, success” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, English. Parents who choose Fath usually hope their child will grow to embody opening, victory, success and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fath total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Fath" carries a deep historical significance in Islamic culture, representing courage, triumph, and the power of God. It is a name given to the warriors who valiantly fought battles and successfully opened victories for their communities and nations. Hence, it is an esteemed name passed down through generations as a source of pride and inspiration.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Fath" embodies the concept of trusting in Allah (God) and having faith that He will grant success and open doors to opportunities. It serves as a reminder that no matter how challenging or impossible a situation may seem, with the help of Allah, we can overcome all obstacles and emerge victorious. Consequently, this name instills hope and confidence in the hearts of those who bear it and inspires them to strive for their personal and spiritual growth.
